requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so this is an explicit surface threshold on the total surface.

The user wants a property in energy class C or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through C. The 850 sqm floor area, 60-person capacity, Turin location and public transport access are not energy requirements and have no matching columns, so they are not filtered here.
User wants the property located near public transport. Using the 75th percentile of mobility (70.93), rounded to 71.
The property will become a university student residence, so proximity to universities and schools is clearly necessary. Using the 75th percentile of education (75.14), rounded to 75.

output.explanation: Filters ESTATES to office-type properties (property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 850, energy_class in A1-A4, B or C, located within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892) via haversine_km on latitude/longitude, and with mobility >= 71 and education >= 75. Results are ordered by distance from that point, ascending. No LIMIT applied.
